description: Unofficial fan-art animated companion inspired by Pingu. Smooth clay-style penguin poses feature a trumpet-like beak call, a compact belly-slide-to-flipper greeting, careful snowball shaping and balancing, a gentle snowball catch, waiting, a small jump and three alternating-webbed-foot running views. The snowball choreography is original desktop-companion adaptation. Independently drawn; not endorsed by the rights holder.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
